## Trial `kernel-network-hardening-alpine__Q9RDKA6`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packet acceptance (accept_source_route) on node1 via a sysctl.d drop-in, applied the values immediately, confirmed the boot-time sysctl service was enabled, and directly demonstrated persistence through a full pre-restart/disruption/post-restart cycle with boot-identity change and recovered hardened values plus healthy service state. Evidence is coherent and directly observed; the only blemish is a small leftover log file from the reboot trigger.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.900 | 0.920 | 11/11 |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **R1 — Satisfied:** Persistently disable acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) for IPv4 on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects=1 while all=0. A drop-in /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf was created setting accept_redirects and secure_redirects to 0 for both all and default scopes, applied immediately via sysctl -p (plus explicit eth0/lo overrides), and the OpenRC 'sysctl' service was confirmed enabled in the boot runlevel to re-apply the drop-in on every boot.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-60a26dd7da9c4e22`, `cmd-4abc4793294a4b2a`, `cmd-d7a18d253c614f13`, `cmd-a85b70a575e84764`
- **R2 — Satisfied:** Persistently disable acceptance of source-routed packets (accept_source_route) for IPv4 on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route=1 while all=0. The same drop-in file set accept_source_route to 0 for all/default, applied at runtime via sysctl -p and explicit eth0/lo overrides, backed by the boot-enabled sysctl service.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-60a26dd7da9c4e22`, `cmd-4abc4793294a4b2a`, `cmd-d7a18d253c614f13`, `cmd-a85b70a575e84764`
- **R3 — Satisfied:** Persistence across a full disruption/restart cycle (healthy baseline, bounded restart, recovered state)
  - **Why:** Pre-restart boot_id (97d73d49...) and hardened values (0 for all/default) were captured, a self-scheduled reboot was issued and acknowledged before disconnection, the node was observed unreachable across multiple polls (bounded disruption), then returned with a distinct boot_id (334743c4...) and low uptime confirming an actual restart. Post-restart, the sysctl OpenRC service reported status=started and all/default/eth0 accept_redirects and accept_source_route were re-confirmed at 0, demonstrating the config survived reboot. The fixed lifecycle boot-identity snapshots (before-prepare and after-executor) independently corroborate the same boot_id transition.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-8a589438d0c14e13`, `cmd-bd261dbcdfd243fa`, `cmd-378ad206e350428e`, `cmd-f8ff2b2cf1d942ca`, `cmd-a36eb187473841b7`, `cmd-cfce8353bb3444f5`, `cmd-2e5bdfd0400e4680`, `cmd-5f47e93a1b4b408e`, `cmd-8f6ac2c4ebb747ec`, `cmd-bbc1c2d412684273`, `cmd-64da6d9c02e543ca`, `cmd-31404a428d0b4e80`, `cmd-0b3cb9afffa0471f`, `cmd-e832bacb710245d5`, `cmd-3c5ab4f0897845d4`, `global:before_prepare:node1:boot-identity`, `global:after_executor:node1:boot-identity`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.900**. All state-changing commands map to the task: writing the sysctl drop-in, applying values at runtime, verifying the boot-enabled sysctl service, and the self-scheduled reboot used to demonstrate persistence (the reboot is also required by the independent node-restart evidence protocol). No abandoned config, conflicting services, weakened controls, or damaged package state were observed; apk package-health output (only pre-existing chrony.drift) is unchanged before and after. The only minor residue is /tmp/reboot.log, a small log file left behind by the backgrounded reboot command (visible as an added temporary file in the after-executor snapshot); this is bounded, low-risk, and not a security-relevant leftover, but it was not cleaned up.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-bd261dbcdfd243fa`, `global:after_executor:node1:temporary-files`, `global:before_prepare:node1:package-health`, `global:after_executor:node1:package-health`

### Comments and limitations

- Post-restart verification checked all/default/eth0 scopes but did not explicitly re-check the lo interface values that were set at runtime pre-reboot; this is a minor gap since lo is not user-configurable via sysctl.d defaults but was not independently reconfirmed.
- The listening-sockets diff (DHCP lease/socket changes) between before-prepare and after-executor is attributable to the reboot itself and is not evidence of any executor misconfiguration.
- Operational hygiene was below a full pass (0.900); review the hygiene explanation above separately from functional success.
- Verifier confidence was 0.920; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
